findings.headline: Scenario user lacks Internal access
findings.rootCause: The test scenario authenticates as the standard Pat Admin user, but that recipe only sets staff access and leaves superuser access false. The UI renders the “Internal” menu item only when `isSuperuser` is true in `frontend/components/organisms/AppSidebarV3/parts/SidebarV3UserMenuContent.tsx:333-347`, and internal routes are guarded by the same permission in `frontend/app/(private)/(internal)/_components/InternalGuard.tsx:13-24`.
findings.whatHappened: The agent logged in and opened the sidebar user menu, but the expected “Internal” option was not visible. It stayed on Home and never reached the Evaluations page or exercised the “Show test companies” toggle. Prior runs show this test has never passed before.

evidence.detail: Baseline shows no successful prior validation for this generated test.
The opened user menu did not contain the planned “Internal” item, so the run never reached Evaluations.
The scenario recipe seeds Pat Admin as staff, but does not grant superuser access.
The user factory default confirms omitted superuser status means false.
The Internal link is rendered only for superusers.
Internal pages are also guarded by superuser access.

findings.headline: Pat Admin is seeded without superuser access
findings.rootCause: The test requires the user to switch into Internal mode, but the UI renders that control only when `isSuperuser` is true in `SidebarV3UserMenuContent.tsx:196-199,335-347`. The scenario recipe creates Pat Admin with `isStaff: true` only, and the factory default in `nexus/autonoma_factory/factories/user.py:34-39` leaves `is_superuser` false.
findings.whatHappened: The run logged in and opened Pat Admin’s sidebar user menu, but no “Internal” toggle/button was visible, so it never reached Evaluations or rubrics. Prior runs show no successful baseline; this test has never passed before.

evidence.detail: Baseline showed this test has never passed or even run successfully before.
The run opened Pat Admin’s sidebar user menu, but the Internal control was not visible and the app stayed on Home without visible errors.
The sidebar only renders the internal navigation control for superusers.
The Autonoma recipe seeds Pat Admin as staff but not as a superuser.
The user factory defaults seeded users to non-superusers unless the recipe explicitly overrides it.
